class APIError(QuickbaseError)

class App(object)
    def create_table(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, single_record_name: str | None = None, plural_record_name: str | None = None) -> 'Table'
    def ensure_table(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, single_record_name: str | None = None, plural_record_name: str | None = None) -> 'Table'
    property id -> str
    def info(self) -> AppInfo
    def roles(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[Role]
    def table(self, name_or_id: str) -> 'Table'
    def tables(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[TableInfo]
    def typed(self, model: type[~R]) -> 'TypedTable[R]'

class AsyncTable(object)
    async def count(self, where: Expression | str | None = None) -> int
    async def create_field(self, label: str, field_type: str, *, choices: Sequence[str] | None = None, required: bool | None = None, unique: bool | None = None, properties: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, formula: str | None = None) -> Field
    async def create_relationship(self, parent: 'AsyncTable', *, foreign_key_label: str, lookup_fields: Sequence[str | int] = ()) -> Relationship
    async def delete(self, where: Expression | str) -> int
    async def delete_fields(self, fields: str | int | Sequence[str | int]) -> None
    async def delete_file_version(self, record_id: int, field: str | int, *, version: int) -> None
    async def download_file(self, record_id: int, field: str | int, *, version: int | None = None) -> FileDownload
    async def drop(self, *, confirm: str) -> None
    async def ensure_field(self, label: str, field_type: str, *, choices: Sequence[str] | None = None, required: bool | None = None, unique: bool | None = None, properties: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, formula: str | None = None) -> Field
    async def ensure_lookup_field(self, relationship: Relationship, parent_field: str | int, *, label: str | None = None) -> Field
    async def ensure_relationship(self, parent: 'AsyncTable', *, foreign_key_label: str) -> Relationship
    async def ensure_summary_field(self, relationship: Relationship, child_field: str | int, label: str, *, function: str = 'SUM') -> Field
    async def fields(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[Field]
    async def first(self, *, where: Expression | str | None = None, select: str | int | Sequence[str | int] | None = None, order_by: str | int | Sequence[str | int] | None = None) -> Record | None
    async def get(self, record_id: int, *, select: str | int | Sequence[str | int] | None = None) -> Record | None
    async def info(self) -> TableInfo
    async def insert(self, rows: Iterable[Mapping[str | int, Any]], *, batch_size: int = 1000) -> WriteResult
    def query(self, *, where: Expression | str | None = None, select: str | int | Sequence[str | int] | None = None, order_by: str | int | Sequence[str | int] | None = None, page_size: int = 1000, limit: int | None = None) -> AsyncRecordIterator
    async def query_page(self, *, where: Expression | str | None = None, select: str | int | Sequence[str | int] | None = None, order_by: str | int | Sequence[str | int] | None = None, top: int = 100, skip: int = 0) -> Page
    async def relationships(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[Relationship]
    def report(self, name_or_id: str) -> 'AsyncReport'
    async def reports(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[ReportInfo]
    async def resolve_field_ids(self, fields: Sequence[str | int]) -> list[int]
    async def run_formula(self, formula: str, *, record_id: int | None = None) -> FormulaResult
    async def update(self, rows: Iterable[Mapping[str | int, Any]], *, batch_size: int = 1000) -> WriteResult
    async def update_field(self, field: str | int, *, label: str | None = None, required: bool | None = None, unique: bool | None = None, properties: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, formula: str | None = None) -> Field
    async def upsert(self, rows: Iterable[Mapping[str | int, Any]], *, merge_on: str | int, batch_size: int = 1000) -> WriteResult

command pyquickbase codegen
    --app (StoreAction, required)
    --output (StoreAction, required)
    --table (AppendAction, default [])
    --token-env (StoreAction, default 'QB_USER_TOKEN')
    --include-links (StoreTrueAction, default False)
    --check (StoreTrueAction, default False)
